C1.definition: Posted-results trials that are interventional with two or more groups on a posted primary measure.

C2.definition: C1 trials whose registered allocation is RANDOMIZED.

posted.definition: Retrieved trials with posted results (hasResults true and a results section).

requested.definition: Trials this build covers (the requested list). See scope for the records fetched and those left out.

retrieved.definition: Requested trials whose record the registry returned.

metrics.definition: hasResults is true and the record carries a results section.
metrics.label: Results posted

metrics.definition: resultsSection.baselineCharacteristicsModule exists and is a non-empty object. Presence only.
metrics.label: Baseline module present

metrics.definition: resultsSection.participantFlowModule exists and is a non-empty object. Presence only.
metrics.label: Participant flow module present

metrics.definition: resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule exists and is a non-empty object. Presence only.
metrics.label: Outcome measures module present

metrics.definition: resultsSection.adverseEventsModule exists and is a non-empty object. Presence only.
metrics.label: Adverse events module present

metrics.definition: At least one baseline measure with a numeric value and a numeric denominator above zero for the Total group, or for every arm.
metrics.label: Baseline table usable (rule B1)

metrics.definition: One period with numeric STARTED and COMPLETED counts for every flow group, STARTED above zero in at least one.
metrics.label: Participant flow usable (rule F1)

metrics.definition: A posted primary measure with a unit, a numeric number analysed for every group (above zero in at least one) and a numeric value for every analysed group.
metrics.label: Primary outcome usable (rule O1)

metrics.definition: Numeric serious and other numbers at risk for every event group (above zero in at least one), plus event rows or explicit totals.
metrics.label: Adverse events usable (rule A1)

metrics.definition: Rules B1, F1, O1 and A1 all pass. These rules test whether a table can be read, not whether its content is correct or complete.
metrics.label: All four tables usable

metrics.definition: Interventional, with at least one posted primary measure that has two or more groups. Structure of the record: two groups are not necessarily two randomised arms.
metrics.label: Two or more groups on a primary measure (C1)

metrics.definition: An analysis on a primary measure that names two or more of its groups and has a p-value or an estimate with both confidence limits.
metrics.label: Between-arm analysis posted on a primary measure

metrics.definition: Such an analysis with a p-value string that contains a digit (a plain number or a bound).
metrics.label: Between-arm analysis with a p-value

metrics.definition: Such an analysis with a numeric estimate, a numeric lower limit and a numeric upper limit.
metrics.label: Between-arm estimate with both confidence limits

metrics.definition: At least one between-arm analysis on a primary measure posts its p-value as a bound such as "<0.001"; the exact value is not posted.
metrics.label: Between-arm p-value posted as a bound

metrics.definition: Rule SG2 found at least one signal in the 18 structured fields of a posted outcome measure. A signal is wording that looks like subgroup reporting; it awaits human review and is not a finding that a subgroup result is posted.
metrics.label: Subgroup reporting detected by the current method: at least one signal

scope.definition: Which of the fetched registry records this build covers. Every count in this file is over the included trials.

rows.definition: Registry records the archive was fetched for.
rows.label: Registry records fetched (the frame)

rows.definition: Trials this build covers: the requested list, one record each in records.json.
rows.label: Trials in this build

rows.definition: Frame records left out of this build. They have no record in records.json and are in no count.
rows.label: Frame records left out
rows.reason: excluded by the outcomes cohort's eligibility rules (see data/outcomes/index.json excluded)

signals.definition: One signal is one match of rule SG2 in one field of one posted outcome measure, for one dimension. "other" is a signal that does not name age, sex, race or ethnicity.

definitions.explicit_subgroup_results_detected: At least one signal accepted by a human review record.
definitions.no_explicit_subgroup_results_detected_in: The 18 listed fields of every posted outcome measure were read and rule SG2 found no signal for the dimension, or a human review record rejected every signal. Posted documents and publications were not read.
definitions.not_applicable_no_posted_results: The registry holds no posted results for the trial (hasResults is false). This describes the registry, not this method.
definitions.not_yet_processed: The trial was requested but its record was not retrieved, so its results were not read with this method version.
definitions.processing_failed_or_indeterminate: The record or its outcome measures could not be parsed, or rule SG2 found at least one signal that no human review record has settled.

subgroup_states.note: Each trial is in exactly one state per dimension. With no human review record, no trial can be in the detected state.

missing_data.definition: What the records do not contain. Each row is a count of trials, with its denominator.

rows.definition: hasResults is false. Nothing about these trials' results is stated.
rows.label: No posted results

rows.definition: Rule O1 failed with this reason.
rows.label: O1 not usable: no_data_table

rows.definition: Rule O1 failed with this reason.
rows.label: O1 not usable: no_numeric_value_for_an_analysed_group

rows.definition: No participants denominator row, or a non-numeric count for a group. Recorded as missing, not zero.
rows.label: Baseline total cannot be formed

rows.definition: No first period, no STARTED milestone in it, no flow group to sum over, or a non-numeric count for a group. Recorded as missing, not zero.
rows.label: Number started cannot be formed

rows.definition: baselineCharacteristicsModule.populationDescription is absent or blank; no population is inferred.
rows.label: No baseline population description

negative_findings.definition: Searches that found nothing, each with the scope of the search.

rows.definition: The rule fired on nothing. This is not a finding that the trial reported no subgroup result anywhere.
rows.label: No subgroup signal found
rows.scope: Rule SG2 over the 18 listed fields of every posted outcome measure. Posted documents, publications and every field not listed were not read.

rows.definition: Absence of a posted analysis is not absence of an analysis: the registry does not require one for every measure, and a publication or study report may hold it.
rows.label: No between-arm analysis posted on a primary measure
rows.scope: analyses[] of posted primary measures in the registry record.

rows.definition: No analyses[] row on any posted primary measure.
rows.label: No statistical analysis of any kind on a primary measure
rows.scope: analyses[] of posted primary measures in the registry record.

rows.definition: The module is present with no serious-event row. With numeric totals this is a report of none; without them it is not.
rows.label: No serious adverse event rows posted

parsing_failures.definition: Retrieved records with at least one section the parser could not read. The record is kept; the section is recorded as not evaluated. n counts trials; rows list each section.

retrieval_failures.definition: Requested trials whose record was not retrieved. Their results were not read.
